purpose: Teach: カルロス/奄美/インディアン/南アフリカ/カイロ/ジョニー/日産/西武

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、カルロス・ゴーン事件のニュース観てたな
lines.en: Riku, you were watching all that news about the Carlos Ghosn scandal, weren't you?
lines.style: Casual accusation, testing him. Quick delivery, slight smirk in the voice. Not mean—playfully catching him out.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行で奄美行ったろ?桜
lines.en: You went to Amami on your school trip, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Redirecting smoothly, slight coolness beneath. Meets her energy but pivots away. Unfazed, almost amused by the turnabout.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でインディアン伝統習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, didn't you study Native American traditions in social studies?
lines.style: Pressing forward, rapid-fire. She's building momentum. Lighter tone now—less serious, more like she's enjoying the rhythm of the exchange.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で南アフリカ・アパルトヘイト習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You learned about South African apartheid in class, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Volleying back without hesitation. Steady, unflinching. He's matching her pace and precision. There's a hint of dry enjoyment underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でカイロ習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, didn't you study Cairo in social studies?
lines.style: Quickening. She's keeping up momentum, slightly breathless. The game is escalating. Sharper attack on each phrase.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ジョニー・デップの映画ばっか観てたな、桜
lines.en: You were always watching Johnny Depp movies, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Wry, almost drawling. Slight pause before the observation lands. Amused by the absurdity of where this is going. Quieter delivery—he's won a point.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん父さん、日産で働いてたな
lines.en: Riku, your dad worked for Nissan, didn't he?
lines.style: Shifts tactic suddenly. Lower register, more pointed. She's no longer playing—testing something real. The playfulness drains slightly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、西武ライオンズ応援してたな、桜
lines.en: You were a Seibu Lions fan, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet, close. Almost intimate. He's said something that matters and he knows it. Gentle but direct. The teasing has stopped.
